x: 17th/18th September - Charlton Park - KENT DECATHLON CHAMP. 1.A.Lattimer (Herne Hill H) 5551 pts 2.J.Wright (Blackheath) 5524 pts 3.B.Townsend (BELGRAVE H) 5403 pts

Graham Taylor, who set a magnificent course record of 1hr.39m.47s. the previous year, was unfortunately prevented from turning out by injury, and with the withdrawal by Peter Yates, the race seemed from the start to lie between Scottish international Jim Wright of Tipton, and Barry Collins of Surrey AC.
His effort of 28:10 was only 5 seconds away from being 3rd fastest, behind Freary and Tipton's Jim Wright, and was just one second better than Basil Heatley, out again up front for Coventry.

Gerry North, always a great performer on the road, had Jim Wright to contend with and gave us a bit of a fright by losing contact during his run but by a magnificent effort at the end pulled up the deficit and raced past Wright to put us in second place 2½ minutes behind Coventry and 2 seconds ahead of Tipton.
